data.caption: Makes The Perfect Gift
data.copy:
If finding the perfect gift feels challenging for you...

Here's the 3-step guide for an excellent gift:

Step #1 – Skip gag gifts
That means no “toilet-shaped mugs”, “Zombie survival guides” or “inflatable unicorn horn for cats” (Yes, there is such a thing.)

Step #2 – Put in a little extra effort
Find something of high quality. Something she’ll always remember and treasure for years. Avoid giving the same socks, ties and jewelry everyone else can find.

Step #3 – Show how much you care
Think of an activity she loves or one you share in common. Every time she uses your gift, she’ll think of you fondly.

Simple right?

So far, over 4,400 customers agree… our hand-crafted ‘Sagrada’ Stemless Wine Glasses check all three boxes:

#1 - Inspired by the beautiful stained-glass windows of the Sagrada Familia in Barcelona.

#2 - Each is a heirloom quality work of art: mouth-blown and hand-painted.

#3 - If she likes travel, culture, art or wine - the look on her face will tell you everything you need to know.

This time... give her a gift she will treasure for years.

Please note: Made by hand in limited quantities, these particular glasses are not always in stock due to high demand.
